params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, pictureObject below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, pictureObject is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: pictureObject
params.description: Object name (if * passed) or Variable/field reference (if * omitted)

params.name: element_ID
params.description: ID of element where one or more attributes are set

params.name: modifyImageItself
params.description: If passed as the last parameter, modifies the SVG picture itself (all current and future form objects using it), even if no form object currently uses it; otherwise only the rendered image already attached to a matching form object is modified.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets one or more attributes (as attribName/attribValue pairs) of an existing element in the SVG rendering tree of a displayed image, or in the internal DOM tree of an image, identified by element_ID.

constraints: The rendered image of the object is only created if SVG SET ATTRIBUTE has been called at least once for it.
The trailing 'modifyImageItself' * is useless (ignored) if pictureObject is an object name; it is only taken into account when pictureObject is a Variable or Field.
